intro.title: STARLUX App Experience Survey
intro.lead: Hi! This survey is to understand which part of using the STARLUX App trips you up the most.
intro.bulletAnon: Anonymous — responses are used only for this study
intro.bulletHonest: No right or wrong answers, just share how it really felt
intro.bulletNoSave: Leaving midway won't save your data
intro.notice: This is an independent personal UI/UX research project and is not affiliated with STARLUX.

field.storyPlaceholder: Write freely. e.g. payment got stuck while booking, the check-in page kept spinning…
